claims.statement: For every genuine Boolean f on disjoint uniform cubes with X-degree at most d, H(f)<=2 I_Y(f)/ln2+2(d-1)-E Gamma_d+A_{1/2}(f), where A_{1/2} is the p_X-average conditional Renyi-half entropy of the Y-spectrum. Fixed A_{1/2}, d and positive variance give dimension-independent FEI. The class strictly contains unbounded-support Boolean fibers, including x times the k-bit AND sign with K_{1/2}<9.
claims.quantifiers: All finite disjoint X,Y; uniform independent physical signs; all genuine Boolean f; integer d>=1; zero fibers omitted.
claims.tensor_guard: A_{1/2}(fg)=A_{1/2}(f)+H_{1/2}(p_g) on a fresh tensor block, excluding repeated positive-entropy arbitrary cores under a fixed cap.
